# Locally bundled animation libraries

GSAP and ScrollTrigger, version 3.15.0. The original license headers are retained in both files.

- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap/v/3.15.0
- Source distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.15.0/dist/
- Documentation: https://gsap.com/docs/v3/
- License: https://gsap.com/standard-license

The portfolio uses these local copies and makes no runtime CDN request. Images, branding and animation implementation belong to this portfolio; no third-party site assets were copied.
